sections.heading: Permanent progression
sections.body: Soulstones purchase permanent character upgrades. The summary shows your available currency and progression, while the tabs organize upgrades into branches.

sections.heading: Branches and prerequisites
sections.body: Select an upgrade to review its current rank, next effect, cost, and prerequisites. Some upgrades require earlier ranks or another node in the same branch before they can be purchased.

sections.heading: Before purchasing
sections.body: Purchasing spends the displayed Soulstones immediately. You can reset all ranks from this page to reclaim their displayed refund value.

sections.heading: Retired constellations
sections.body: If your character has retired constellations, including Sigil Traces, their ranks remain visible with no active effect. Use Refund retired upgrades to reclaim their displayed Soulstone value while keeping active upgrades. Refunded retired ranks cannot be purchased again.
